column1: # node_helmet custom partition table (8 MB flash).
# Reserved for a future esp-sr wake-word model (Kconfig.projbuild PS_WAKE_ESP_SR).
# Empty today: the default wake path is the pure-C energy gate (ps_egate)
# which needs no model data. Sized for a typical WakeNet9/ESP-SR small model
# (a few hundred KB) with headroom; mounted as a SPIFFS/model partition only
# when CONFIG_PS_WAKE_ESP_SR is selected and esp-sr is vendored.
